             Manage projects, people, invites, links, and\n                              shared access\n  inbox [options]             Incoming project invites and share links\n\nSecrets\n  read [options] <reference>  Read one clawdi:// secret reference\n  inject [options]            Render clawdi:// references in a template\n  run [options] <command...>  Run a command with clawdi:// references resolved\n\nCloud Agents\n  deploy [options]            Create a Cloud Agent with an interactive,\n                              payment-aware wizard\n  wallet                      Inspect Clawdi wallet\n  ai-provider                 Manage AI providers\n  channel                     Manage channel bots and pair external chats to\n                              agents\n  agent                       Manage agents\n\nMaintenance\n  config                      Read or write CLI configuration\n                              (~/.clawdi/config.json)\n  teardown [options]          Reverse setup: remove env file, bundled skill, and\n                              MCP entry\n  update [options]            Install the latest CLI through the current\n                              installation owner\n  mcp [options]               Start MCP server (stdio transport, used by agents)\n\nCommands:\n  help [command]              display help for command\n\nExamples:\n  $ clawdi auth login               Sign in to Clawdi\n  $ clawdi deploy                   Create a Cloud Agent with the deploy wizard\n  $ clawdi auth status --json       Inspect credential source without printing secrets\n  $ clawdi setup                    Detect agents and register the current machine\n  $ clawdi session list             Preview local sessions before pushing\n  $ clawdi push --all Suppress the non-blocking update check\n  CLAWDI_NO_AUTO_UPDATE    Skip CLI/daemon background auto-update (also disables via `config set autoUpdate false`)\n  CLAWDI_AUTH_TOKEN        Authenticate
